items_missed: No 'How are you today?' after greeting
No agenda statement (didn't outline the call structure/time estimate) and no explicit 'Sound good?' confirmation
Never asked if customer needs packing services, so packing service pricing was never covered
Meet Your Mover program not mentioned
Save Your Ass speech skipped the 'take a carload' tip and had no explicit 'does that make sense?' close
No mention of a bolded details list at the top of the confirmation email
Didn't ask customer to reply with corrections to the email
Didn't ask 'any other questions before I let you go?' or give hours/how to reach us before ending the call
Used customer's first name only once (needed 3+)
No size equivalents (e.g., school bus reference) used to frame the estimate
Insurance explanation covered the $2,000 No Worries coverage but not the 60 cent/lb baseline
No rapport-building humor or laugh moment
top_strength: Thoroughly probed both the origin house and destination storage-unit details (address, size, boxes, driveway/floor access) and delivered a clear, itemized pricing breakdown that correctly flagged the trip fee, drive-time driver of the higher estimate range, and the on-time guarantee.
coaching_note: The open (no agenda statement) and close (no 'any other questions,' no hours, no bolded-email/reply-with-corrections mention) were both skipped, and Meet Your Mover never came up — tightening those bookend moments would move this call well past a passing score without changing anything in the middle.
phone_presence_notes: Polite and helpful throughout (handled the mid-call hold gracefully, proactively offered the storage-pad option) but transactional overall — minimal empathy language, only one use of the customer's name, and no rapport/humor beyond the task at hand.
